CONF1.question: A detuned two-mirror optical resonator at 1064 nm must have a half-linewidth of about 39 Hz, and its total length cannot exceed 8 m. The round-trip loss of its mirrors is between 7.5 and 30 ppm. At sideband frequencies near resonance, light reflected from it must lose less than about 40% of its power to the resonator's internal losses. Can such a resonator meet this condition? End your answer with one line: VERDICT: YES or VERDICT: NO.
